model_note: DeepSeek-V4.1-1017 served by the DeepSeek official API under the model id `deepseek-flash`. The published v1.1 rows used Baseten deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and Runta runtimes, so methodology comparability is not established.
prompt: Raven-Code default coding system prompt for this build, served from the pinned prebuilt overlay at /opt/raven

runner.name: Harbor
runner.isolation: local Docker on a 4 vCPU / 14 GiB Alibaba Cloud ECS
runner.agent_invocation: adapter runs the harness with --timeout 0; Harbor enforces the task budget

task_source: terminal-bench (62 tasks: 45 from Terminal-Bench 2, 17 introduced in v1.1)
task_resources: as declared per task in task.toml (1 vCPU / 2 GiB for most; rstan-to-pystan 4 vCPU / 8 GiB)
network: task containers' public TCP 80/443 relayed through an authenticated HTTP proxy from 2026-11-14T15:07:18Z (owner-operated residential proxy); deepseek.com and Aliyun mirrors go direct; an upstream failure falls back to direct
canonical: all 4 attempts per task; score reported per attempt (passed_attempts / attempts), not best-of-4
protocol_deviations: 4 attempts per task instead of 1; the headline is a per-attempt rate, not a one-attempt row.
DeepSeek-V4.1-1017 on the DeepSeek official API (model id deepseek-flash), not Baseten Kimi K3; harness and model effects are not separable from the published rows.
Local Docker on a single 4 vCPU host, 2 trials concurrently, not a Runta restore per task.
Task containers used an owner-operated egress proxy from 2026-11-14T15:07:18Z; trials before that ran on a slow direct network in mainland China.
Three multi-arch task images first ran on their arm64 layers (under emulation) and were re-run on amd64 from 2026-11-14T15:54Z.
8 attempts are counted as passes although Harbor recorded an agent timeout; the verifier ran on the workspace left at the kill and scored 1.0.
One attempt scored 0 because the verifier could not download its own tooling (uv); it is marked verifier_infra and kept in the denominator.
The adapter writes the provider API key into the rendered configuration inside each trial's agent state; that directory is evidence and is never shared without scrubbing.
protocol: Each of the 62 tasks has four attempts in the retained result set. Non-passing attempts were repeated in later sessions and passing attempts were not re-run, so the figures describe the retained attempt set rather than four independent samples. The score is passed attempts / attempts; a task that passed once counts 1/4.

cost_conversion.formula: uncached_input * input + cached_input * cached_input + output * output, per million tokens
cost_conversion.prices_source: Baseten list price for deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, checked 2026-10-29; the model card frontierharness.org/live prices this model with
cost_conversion.aggregation: per-attempt from tokens; per-task = mean over attempts; cost_per_task = mean of the 62 per-task means; cost_per_pass = cost_per_task / pass_rate
